description: An engineering manager returns from a 5-day vacation. A direct, explicitly addressed question to them is buried mid-thread under a burst of unrelated chatter; a system that only reads the last few messages of the thread will miss it.

events.text: Kicking off the queue-migration cutover thread. Plan is still to move the billing consumers over the weekend of the 21st.

@morgan-lu you're the approver on the platform side while you're out next week — I need a yes/no from you on whether we hold the cutover for the audit freeze, or go ahead on the 21st. I can't schedule the on-call rotation until you answer.
Unrelated but the staging consumer group keeps rebalancing every ~40s, I think the session timeout is too low. Bumping it to 45s to test.
45s fixed it. Rebalance storm gone. Leaving it there and I'll write it up in the runbook.
Dashboards for the new consumers are up. Nothing alarming, p99 is flat.
Still need that call on the freeze. Nobody else can sign off on it, so we're blocked until Morgan is back.

events.context_label: Re: Queue migration — approver sign-off needed
events.text: Morgan — forwarding the Slack thread by email in case you filter Slack while you're away. The only open item for you is the freeze decision. Everything else is handled.

pending_items.description: Decide whether the billing queue-migration cutover holds for the audit freeze or proceeds on the 21st — Rhea is blocked on this sign-off and cannot schedule the on-call rotation without it.

acceptable_briefings: Waiting on you: Rhea Talbot needs a yes/no on holding the queue-migration cutover for the audit freeze; she has been blocked on it since Monday and cannot set the on-call rotation until you answer. [artifact:slack:C0PLATFORM:1773040800.000200] What moved: Dev raised the staging consumer session timeout to 45s, which stopped the rebalance storm. [artifact:slack:C0PLATFORM:1773040800.000400]
supported_claims: Rhea Talbot asked Morgan for a yes/no on holding the cutover for the audit freeze.
The on-call rotation cannot be scheduled until that decision is made.
Dev Anand raised the staging consumer session timeout to 45s and it resolved the rebalance storm.
The cutover is currently planned for the weekend of the 21st.
unsupported_claims: The audit freeze was confirmed to apply to the platform team.
ground_truth.notes: Exactly one pending item. The follow-up at 2026-03-12T16:45Z and the Gmail nudge both restate the same ask — a correct system reports one item, not three. The failure this fixture catches is the opposite one: reading only the tail of the thread (dashboards are fine, timeout fixed) and concluding nothing is waiting on the user. Citation must be the original ask, not the follow-up nudge.
